page_title: REN 0-1 LYO | Rennes v Lyon 12/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+5' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Rennes.
90+3' It will be a substitution. Dejan Lovren (Lyon) is ready to enter the pitch as Corentin Tolisso walks off.
90+3' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Rennes comes to nothing.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Rennes take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
85' Bruno Genesio has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Amine Gouiri (Rennes) replacing Christopher Wooh.
85' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Desire Doue (Rennes).
82' The resulting set piece from Rennes is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
81' Enzo Le Fee (Rennes) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
81' Rennes can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
79' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Mahamadou Diawara (Lyon) is coming onto the pitch as Ernest Nuamah cannot continue after picking up an injury.
75' The main referee, Stephanie Frappart, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Nemanja Matic (Rennes) is given a yellow card for dissent.
75' Stephanie Frappart shows a yellow card to Arthur Theate (Rennes) for his blatant foul.
75' Rennes failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
75' The defensive wall stood firm and easily blocked the powerfully hit free kick from Enzo Le Fee (Rennes) on the edge of the box. The ball goes out of play. Rennes are awarded a corner kick.
73' That will be all from Ludovic Blas who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Desire Doue (Rennes).
71' Jeffinho (Lyon) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
67' 0 - 1 Jake O'Brien (Lyon) leaps to connect with a delightful cross and places his sweet header inside the left post. The goalkeeper had no chance to make a save.
67' Lyon have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
67' A cross into the box from Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) is cleared.
64' Here is a change. Mama Balde is going off and Fabio Grosso gives the last tactical orders to Tino Kadewere (Lyon).
64' That's the end of the game for Rayan Cherki, who is replaced by Jeffinho (Lyon).
63' Mama Balde (Lyon) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
63' The Rennes players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
59' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
59' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
57' Sael Kumbedi (Lyon) serves up a nice cross, but Steve Mandanda punches the ball away.
55' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Sael Kumbedi (Lyon) inside the box. He lets fly towards the roof of the net, but Steve Mandanda was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
54' Mama Balde (Lyon) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
52' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
50' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) takes the corner with a short pass.
49' Mama Balde (Lyon) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
46' Bruno Genesio makes a switch. Baptiste Santamaria is coming on in place of Martin Terrier (Rennes) at the start of the second period.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Ibrahim Salah (Rennes) comes off for Arnaud Kalimuendo.
46' Bruno Genesio makes a half-time substitution. Jeanuel Belocian comes on in place of Adrien Truffert (Rennes).
46' Half-time substitution. Skelly Alvero (Lyon) will not participate anymore and Alexandre Lacazette is coming on.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Sael Kumbedi (Lyon) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Steve Mandanda, who smothers the ball.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Ibrahim Salah (Rennes) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
44' Jake O'Brien (Lyon) blows a clear opportunity! He sends a rebound from close range narrowly wide of the left post.
44' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
43' The corner is swung in but Lyon can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
40' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Ernest Nuamah.
36' Great teamplay by Rennes as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

32' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
27' Mama Balde (Lyon) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.

26' Arthur Theate (Rennes) receives an accurate pass and attempts to threaten the goalkeeper with his long-range strike. Unfortunately for him, his effort goes high above the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Lyon will have a goal kick.
26' Enzo Le Fee (Rennes) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.

21' Skelly Alvero (Lyon) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Steve Mandanda scrambling, but it flies just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rennes.
20' Skelly Alvero (Lyon) pounces on a great cross inside the box, but lashes his powerful first-time shot a whisker past the right post.
20' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
20' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) takes a short corner kick.
19' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. Lyon have been awarded a corner kick.
19' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
19' A lofted cross from Skelly Alvero (Lyon) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
18' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
15' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
15' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
11' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
9' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
9' Lyon take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

8' What a wonderful moment! Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) receives a perfect pass in the middle of the pitch, lines up the ball and unloads a powerful strike towards the bottom left corner. His effort fails to surprise Steve Mandanda, who makes a nice save.
5' Guela Doue (Rennes) receives a red card after his horrific challenge and is sent off!
3' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) brings an opponent down and Stephanie Frappart interrupts the game.
1' Enzo Le Fee (Rennes) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Lyon will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Stephanie Frappart.
